dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: *sigh* My brother is so pathetic. He doesn't even dare to eat any of the food that he ordered himself.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I've tried some of the food before, and that's just how it is!

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: It's not that I dislike it, let's just say that I'm... disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Take Zhongyuan Chop Suey, for example. All the spices they use completely overwhelm the natural flavor of the ingredients. Apart from the powerful spicy and salty flavors, there is no taste of the actual ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I had anticipated that it would be a more shocking taste, but I didn't at all expect this.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: We'll consult the Teyvat Travel Guide again to see where we should head next on our culinary journey.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Goodbye. We'll be heading out shortly ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen somebody who looks similar to me?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Similar looking to you... a sibling, you mean? Not that I remember.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I understand how you must feel. If I were to get separated from my brother, I mean, if one of us wandered off and got lost or something, that would be... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: In any case, I will help you keep an eye out during your travels. May you find them soon.
